source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In a retrospective study of 106 NF1 patients treated with CO2 laser for cutaneous neurofibromas, more than 90% were satisfied and reported minimal pain, good healing and few complications.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 93 Meni 2015 PMID 25662097. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.Retrospective; no randomized comparison. Evidence type cohort_study is used because clinical procedures are not a drug but the contract permits it for drug_response.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 93
